title: Separate actor and subject
requirement: MUST separate login account, patient, caregiver, professional, organisation member and payer identifiers.
verification: Switch a dependent profile without changing the authenticated actor.

title: Effective hierarchy
requirement: MUST store typed parent/reporting relationships with start/end dates and reject cycles.
verification: A historical return retains its original reporting scope after a zone transfer.

title: Scoped grants
requirement: MUST bind roles to resource scope, validity, grantor and delegation depth; default deny.
verification: A zone officer cannot read another zone through API/export.

title: Multiple contexts
requirement: MUST show an explicit context selector and clear drafts/cache when subject changes.
verification: A clinician who is also a patient sees separated workspaces.

title: Privileged identity
requirement: MUST require strong authentication for professional, reviewer, finance and administrative actions.
verification: An ordinary patient session cannot elevate itself.

title: Delegation
requirement: MUST record acting assignments, expiry, conflicts and accepted handover of open work.
verification: An expired acting officer loses new decisions but historical authorship remains.

title: Offboarding
requirement: MUST revoke grants/sessions, reassign work and queue node revocation updates.
verification: An offline node reports its permission freshness and receives revocation on reconnect.

title: Recovery
requirement: MUST support verified account recovery without silently merging patients or bypassing professional credential checks.
verification: Changed email preserves correct subject linkage and access history.

title: Stable site identity
requirement: MUST distinguish operating organisation, physical/virtual service site and external registry identifiers.
verification: One owner with two hospitals produces two sites, not duplicate owners.

title: Ownership categories
requirement: MUST separately label ministry-owned, member-owned and external ownership/relationship.
verification: A member-owned hospital is never published as ministry-owned.

title: Separate status axes
requirement: MUST store affiliation, statutory evidence, publication, service capability and live readiness independently.
verification: Expired readiness does not erase historical affiliation.

title: Duplicate stewardship
requirement: MUST suggest duplicates and require reviewed link/merge with preserved identifiers and audit.
verification: A later import does not create a second count of the same site.

title: Scoped publication
requirement: MUST publish only approved public fields with current eligibility and verification dates.
verification: Evidence documents and private staff contacts remain private.

title: Suitable search
requirement: MUST filter service/population suitability before proximity; allow manual location and list access.
verification: No GPS still allows a usable search and accessible results.

title: Truthful availability
requirement: MUST distinguish listed hours, capability, readiness and confirmed acceptance.
verification: An emergency contact is labelled as contact information, not dispatch.

title: Change lifecycle
requirement: MUST review material changes and propagate closures/restrictions to directory and routing.
verification: Withdrawn site disappears from new recommendations while history remains.

title: Applicable criteria
requirement: MUST select a versioned criterion set by facility type, services and jurisdiction.
verification: An application retains the criteria used for its decision.

title: Evidence provenance
requirement: MUST retain original evidence, issuer/source, expiry and verification outcomes.
verification: Reviewer comments never overwrite applicant documents.

title: Inspection independence
requirement: MUST assign competent inspectors, record conflicts and distinguish observed from self-reported findings.
verification: Conflicted assessors cannot silently approve their own findings.

title: Corrective work
requirement: MUST give findings, response rights, corrective actions, deadlines and evidence of resolution.
verification: A submitted correction awaits review rather than auto-closing.

title: Central decision
requirement: MUST restrict approve/conditional/reject/renew/suspend/remove decisions to authorised Directorate roles.
verification: A region reviewer can recommend but cannot activate affiliation.

title: Recognition meaning
requirement: MUST show exact scope, conditions, effective/expiry dates and separate statutory status.
verification: The public badge cannot imply government accreditation.

title: Renewal
requirement: MUST schedule reassessment under an adopted calendar and prevent silent expiry extension.
verification: A proposed renewal retains prior decision and current expiry.

title: Review and continuity
requirement: MUST preserve notices, reasons, response, review/appeal and reinstatement; transfer active care responsibilities.
verification: Suspension does not delete clinical/financial/inspection history.

title: Obligation calendar
requirement: MUST version expected reporting units, period, due date, indicator set and scope by effective date.
verification: A later zone transfer does not rewrite historical completeness.

title: Automatic preparation
requirement: MUST prefill from authorised LW EMR/integration data with visible lineage and gaps.
verification: An officer reviews a generated return without retyping known totals.

title: Multiple channels
requirement: MUST support direct forms, controlled bulk imports and authenticated interfaces.
verification: Imported rows receive equivalent validation and evidence rules.

title: Missingness
requirement: MUST distinguish nil, unknown, missing, partial, late and not-applicable.
verification: No submission cannot appear as zero illness.

title: Separate streams
requirement: MUST keep facility encounters, unique patients, community events and ministry population denominators distinct.
verification: A referral appearing at two facilities does not become two unique people.

title: Attestation and review
requirement: MUST record submitter, source period/version and scoped verification.
verification: Submission alone never produces a verified executive count.

title: Correction lineage
requirement: MUST preserve submitted versions, reasons and reviewer decisions; recompute affected aggregates.
verification: A revised death count is traceable in old/new snapshots.

title: Template reconciliation
requirement: MUST reconcile the draft form catalogue with the Director supplied templates before adoption.
verification: Every mandated field is mapped, replaced with rationale or recorded as a gap.

title: Event categories
requirement: MUST version event types, reporting source, occurrence time, location precision and review owner.
verification: A death notification is not automatically a certified cause of death.

title: Minimum capture
requirement: MUST allow a concise initial notification and subsequent structured completion.
verification: Reporter can preserve an urgent signal without completing an unnecessary long form.

title: Review state
requirement: MUST distinguish signal, under-review, verified, duplicate, unsubstantiated and closed.
verification: Executive views do not relabel every report as a confirmed disease case.

title: Urgency ownership
requirement: MUST route time-sensitive work to an actually covered team with acknowledgement/escalation.
verification: No owner/coverage creates an explicit operational exception.

title: Privacy purpose
requirement: MUST minimise identifiable details and restrict case-level clinical safety review.
verification: A general coordinator cannot retrieve confidential incident narratives.

title: Learning
requirement: MUST record contributing factors, corrective actions and reviewed learning separately from individual blame.
verification: An incident review yields an accepted action and follow-up.

title: Duplicates
requirement: MUST relate reports of the same occurrence across community/facility channels without erasing sources.
verification: Multiple notifications can resolve to one reviewed event.

title: Statutory interface
requirement: MUST preserve jurisdiction-specific external reporting obligations and receipts where adopted.
verification: A ministry notification is not presented as completed government reporting.

title: Validation layers
requirement: MUST apply schema, code/unit, temporal, arithmetic, cross-field and historical consistency checks.
verification: A count cannot be negative or exceed its applicable total without a defined exception.

title: Severity
requirement: MUST distinguish blocking errors, review warnings and informational findings.
verification: A warning override requires a reason and reviewer attribution.

title: Source verification
requirement: MUST record evidence examined, method, scope and verifier.
verification: Verified means the named check was performed, not universal accuracy.

title: Stewardship queue
requirement: MUST assign duplicate, unmapped-code, missing-source and conflicting-data cases.
verification: A failed import cannot silently drop invalid rows.

title: Corrections
requirement: MUST preserve raw source, corrected value, reason, author and downstream impact.
verification: An analyst cannot edit a signed source note through a dashboard.

title: Reproducibility
requirement: MUST version rules, source extracts and aggregation runs.
verification: A historical snapshot can be reproduced with its original definitions.

title: Quality visibility
requirement: MUST expose completeness, timeliness, verification coverage and limitations next to measures.
verification: A high headline count does not hide poor source coverage.

title: Feedback
requirement: MUST return actionable findings to the responsible unit and track resolution.
verification: Repeated data-quality failures produce training/improvement work.

title: Role views
requirement: MUST provide distinct leadership, Directorate operational, region, zone and facility defaults.
verification: A senior strategic view is concise; operational users can reach their tasks.

title: Measurement contract
requirement: MUST display period, unit, denominator, coverage, freshness and definition access.
verification: A rate with unreliable population denominator is withheld or labelled appropriately.

title: Verified and provisional
requirement: MUST visibly separate verified snapshots, provisional operational signals and forecasts.
verification: A model narrative cannot elevate unverified reports.

title: Disclosure
requirement: MUST apply purpose/scoped views, small-cell and differencing protections to UI, API and exports.
verification: A CSV cannot bypass a suppressed cell.

title: Actionability
requirement: MUST link a concern to source evidence, an authorised action and its accountable owner.
verification: A leadership decision can be followed through to reviewed outcome.

title: Historical comparison
requirement: MUST show hierarchy/definition changes and comparable cohorts.
verification: A region split does not create a false unexplained improvement.

title: Unknown states
requirement: MUST distinguish zero, missing, stale and unavailable.
verification: Backend failure cannot show a clean zero-demand dashboard.

title: Narrative assistance
requirement: MUST source-link AI summaries and retain deterministic numeric reconciliation.
verification: Unsupported causal or clinical claims are withheld for review.

title: Evidence-linked action
requirement: MUST link each intervention to a finding, decision or justified request with scope and intended result.
verification: An action can be traced to the information that prompted it.

title: Acceptance
requirement: MUST distinguish assigned from accepted responsibility and require a fallback owner.
verification: An unaccepted task remains on the assigning owner exception board.

title: Resources
requirement: MUST record required resources, budget authority, dependencies and due/review dates.
verification: Unfunded work is visible rather than reported as underway.

title: Progress evidence
requirement: MUST record milestones, impediments and completion evidence.
verification: An email delivery cannot mark a clinic improvement complete.

title: Outcome review
requirement: MUST distinguish activity completion from observed outcome and causal claim.
verification: A completed campaign does not automatically claim reduced illness.

title: Reopening
requirement: MUST support rejected completion, recurrence, owner change and reopening with history.
verification: An overdue action cannot disappear through reassignment.

title: Escalation
requirement: MUST trigger owned overdue/dependency escalation under adopted calendars.
verification: Reminder failures create an alternative support task.

title: Learning
requirement: MUST retain lessons, templates and follow-on actions within permitted disclosure.
verification: Sensitive case details do not leak into general learning content.

title: Clinic scope
requirement: MUST declare approved services/populations, staff, equipment, hours and referral routes per clinic.
verification: An unstaffed clinic cannot appear operational.

title: Readiness assertions
requirement: MUST time-bound readiness by service and source, including temporary constraints.
verification: A closed maternity service is excluded despite an active facility listing.

title: Suitable matching
requirement: MUST consider clinical need, capability, location, access and readiness before travel distance.
verification: A nearby unsuitable centre is not ranked as an appropriate destination.

title: Referral states
requirement: MUST distinguish request, acknowledgement, acceptance, departure, receipt and outcome.
verification: Sending a request does not prove the receiving facility accepted.

title: Safe handover
requirement: MUST include authorised summary, owner, transport/communication needs and outstanding results.
verification: A receiving team explicitly accepts its responsibility.

title: Unavailability
requirement: MUST preserve originating ownership on decline/unreachable service and offer owned alternatives.
verification: The patient is not left with a failed transfer and no responsible team.

title: Emergency channels
requirement: MUST show only verified local response contacts and actual dispatch/acceptance receipts.
verification: No universal ambulance coverage is implied.

title: Closed loop
requirement: MUST record receiving outcome, follow-up, feedback and unresolved obligations.
verification: Referral closure cannot discard a pending critical result.

title: Content provenance
requirement: MUST store author, reviewer, sources, purpose, audience, jurisdiction, language and version.
verification: A clinical article has an accountable qualified reviewer.

title: Approval and expiry
requirement: MUST separate drafting, review, approval, publication, review-due, withdrawal and correction.
verification: Unapproved/withdrawn clinical content cannot be served as current guidance.

title: Policy accuracy
requirement: MUST use separately approved ministry wording rather than infer restrictions from unclear audio.
verification: Unresolved transcript phrases are absent from live treatment instructions.

title: Accessible delivery
requirement: MUST support concise text, readable documents and contextual links without compulsory long onboarding.
verification: Patient can read the relevant explanation from the care-plan task.

title: Targeted distribution
requirement: MUST use consented preferences and permitted audience segments without exposing diagnoses in notifications.
verification: A lock-screen message contains a neutral prompt.

title: Linked support
requirement: MUST link content to appropriate care/referral/contact paths and explain its purpose.
verification: Education does not silently replace needed clinical review.

title: Correction propagation
requirement: MUST identify affected versions/audiences and distribute meaningful corrections.
verification: An offline cache marks expired content and receives withdrawal on reconnect.

title: Feedback and effect
requirement: MUST separate delivery, engagement, understanding and health outcomes.
verification: A delivered campaign is not reported as proven behaviour change.

title: One episode
requirement: MUST preserve episode identity across conversation, review, appointment, consultation, referral and follow-up.
verification: Patient does not repeat an intake when a clinician accepts the case.

title: Truthful assistance
requirement: MUST label automated assistance and distinguish received, clinician-acknowledged and assessed.
verification: AI greeting never implies a clinician has reviewed the patient.

title: Clinical routing
requirement: MUST use approved low-risk protocols and emergency escalation independently of payment/AI availability.
verification: Unknown critical information cannot default to a reassuring negative.

title: Covered service
requirement: MUST match by privileges, jurisdiction, capacity, continuity and service hours.
verification: Unavailable coverage gives a truthful next step and owner.

title: Consult recovery
requirement: MUST preserve draft and episode during call/network failure, with alternative review/reschedule.
verification: Disconnected video does not sign, complete or bill care automatically.

title: Clinical completion
requirement: MUST require an authorised signed assessment and owned follow-up/results.
verification: An unresolved result survives consultation completion.

title: Facility link
requirement: MUST exchange a permitted referral/summary and await receiving acceptance.
verification: A facility appointment is not confirmed from a sent request alone.

title: Care finance
requirement: MUST separate clinical urgency, entitlement, price acceptance, payment and settlement.
verification: Urgent guidance works without login or settled payment.

title: Identity crosswalk
requirement: MUST preserve local patient IDs, issuing facility and reviewed cross-network identity links.
verification: A name/date similarity cannot silently merge two charts.

title: Disclosure lanes
requirement: MUST separate aggregate/anonymised intelligence, protected coded cases and authorised identified care records.
verification: A coded summary never appears in a public/general facility browse list.

title: Grant contract
requirement: MUST record subject, recipient/team, purpose, records/fields, legal authority, validity and revocation.
verification: Access beyond a granted purpose or record scope is denied.

title: Minimum clinical view
requirement: MUST use appropriate source-attributed summaries and obtain further access when required.
verification: The receiving team can identify unknown, absent and conflicting facts.

title: Correct-patient check
requirement: MUST validate recipient, subject linkage and treatment context before integrating a disclosure into a clinical chart.
verification: An authorisation token alone cannot attach records to an unmatched patient.

title: Provenance and correction
requirement: MUST retain authorship, source version, signature/attestation and addenda.
verification: Receiving an amended report does not erase the prior signed version.

title: Revocation
requirement: MUST stop future access/disclosure and notify replicas under the adopted retention/access policy.
verification: Revocation does not pretend already lawfully retained clinical documentation never existed.

title: Patient visibility
requirement: MUST provide readable access history, sharing controls and correction requests.
verification: A patient can see recipient/purpose and contest an incorrect link.

title: Programme definition
requirement: MUST version eligibility, covered services, limits, periods, fund restrictions and accountable operator.
verification: A benefit cannot be offered outside its approved terms.

title: Subject and payer
requirement: MUST separate patient, beneficiary, sponsor, payer and contracting institution.
verification: A sponsor account does not become a patient caregiver.

title: Reservations
requirement: MUST reserve entitlements atomically with idempotency and expiry/release rules.
verification: Concurrent requests cannot spend the same balance twice.

title: Fulfilment evidence
requirement: MUST settle benefits against actual qualifying service evidence.
verification: A booked or cancelled service is not automatically a consumed benefit.

title: Adjustments
requirement: MUST use reasoned maker-checker adjustments, reversals and reconciliation.
verification: An operator cannot approve their own balance correction.

title: Disclosure
requirement: MUST report permitted aggregate impact and financial usage with small-cohort protections.
verification: Sponsor export cannot reveal clinical notes through beneficiary identifiers.

title: Financial classification
requirement: MUST distinguish cash received, restricted funds, payable liabilities and earned service revenue.
verification: Funding receipt is not automatically recognised as service revenue.

title: Urgency independence
requirement: MUST keep urgent clinical guidance and priority independent of entitlement balance.
verification: An exhausted benefit presents a funding route without changing clinical urgency.

title: Use-case registry
requirement: MUST version intended use, user, data scope, tools, owner, review class and evaluation.
verification: An unregistered assistant cannot call privileged production tools.

title: Bounded retrieval
requirement: MUST supply only authorised subject/facility/purpose context with source references.
verification: Prompt injection cannot request another patient or payroll dataset.

title: Clinical review
requirement: MUST require clinician review for consequential assessment, orders, prescribing, signing and treatment changes.
verification: AI drafts cannot directly execute those commands.

title: Institutional authority
requirement: MUST retain human review for affiliation, sanctions, protected disclosures and funding approvals.
verification: A model score cannot activate recognition or release funds.

title: Approved protocols
requirement: MUST execute only current, signed, applicable protocol rules with exclusions and escalation.
verification: Unknown safety inputs never default to a safe classification.

title: Memory correction
requirement: MUST distinguish patient report, observed fact, clinician decision and derived summary with lineage.
verification: Correcting a source invalidates dependent memories/summaries.

title: Evaluation and cost
requirement: MUST compare usefulness, errors, latency, staff correction burden and cost against a baseline.
verification: A fluent answer with unsupported facts fails evaluation.

title: AI-off continuity
requirement: MUST preserve core institutional and clinical workflows without inference.
verification: Cloud/model outage cannot prevent local care, signing or reporting.

title: Progressive registration
requirement: MUST capture the minimum viable identity/contact and expand only for care or legal need.
verification: Emergency/unknown patients can receive provisional IDs without fabricated demographics.

title: Local identifiers
requirement: MUST issue collision-resistant site-qualified identifiers and preserve external identifier systems.
verification: Offline registration does not depend on central sequence allocation.

title: Identity safeguards
requirement: MUST support patient/representative confirmation and context-appropriate independent identifiers.
verification: A bed number alone is not treated as permanent patient identity.

title: Longitudinal facts
requirement: MUST separate history, problems, allergies, medicines, observations, procedures and plans with source/status.
verification: Unknown allergy status differs from no known allergies and from no recorded data.

title: Sensitive attributes
requirement: MUST distinguish recorded sex/gender and relevant physiological/clinical context where needed.
verification: Missing attributes are not inferred from name or ministry role.

title: Duplicate resolution
requirement: MUST require reviewed matching/merge and preserve reversible source crosswalks.
verification: Conflicting charts cannot be destructively merged by a similarity score.

title: Documentation integrity
requirement: MUST support drafts, attestation, signed versions, addenda and entered-in-error correction.
verification: An amendment preserves the original signed statement.

title: Patient continuity
requirement: MUST link encounters, episodes, dependants/caregivers, access grants and pending obligations without conflating them.
verification: An adult dependant profile does not give another family member blanket access.

title: Arrival paths
requirement: MUST support booked, walk-in, referred and emergency arrivals with correct patient matching.
verification: An urgent arrival can bypass nonessential administrative completion.

title: Triage governance
requirement: MUST record observations, source, urgency assessment and assessor under an approved local triage policy.
verification: AI cannot independently certify a low-risk clinical disposition.

title: Queue ownership
requirement: MUST distinguish arrival, triage, assigned, acknowledged and assessment; capacity is explicit.
verification: Patients/staff see who owns unacknowledged work.

title: Structured encounter
requirement: MUST support complaint/history, examination, assessment, problems, plan, orders and follow-up with unknowns.
verification: No examination is auto-filled from a conversational summary.

title: Privilege checks
requirement: MUST check clinician/service/jurisdiction authority at consequential actions.
verification: An expired/unprivileged user cannot sign or prescribe.

title: Parallel teamwork
requirement: MUST allow role-scoped observations and tasks while protecting signed content and current orders.
verification: Concurrent edits create conflict/review rather than lost clinical facts.

title: Disposition
requirement: MUST support home plan, observation, admission, referral and emergency transfer with owned obligations.
verification: Encounter completion cannot orphan a pending result.

title: Continuity
requirement: MUST create clear patient instructions, reminders and responsible review tasks.
verification: A delivered reminder alone does not close clinical follow-up.

title: Admission and bed
requirement: MUST distinguish admission order, actual admission, bed reservation and occupancy with local concurrency control.
verification: Two simultaneous assignments cannot occupy one exclusive bed.

title: Responsible team
requirement: MUST assign consultant/duty team, nursing responsibility and shift handover.
verification: Ending a shift does not erase care ownership.

title: Nursing care
requirement: MUST support observations, nursing assessments, care tasks, fluid/intake-output where appropriate and escalation.
verification: Late-entry observations retain actual observation and recorded times.

title: Medication administration
requirement: MUST integrate current signed orders and actual administration/omission records.
verification: A dispensed medicine is not automatically marked administered.

title: Rounds and orders
requirement: MUST show current plans, results, active orders, critical acknowledgements and outstanding work.
verification: A discontinued order cannot remain silently active on a stale task view.

title: Transfer
requirement: MUST record sender/receiver, ward/bed, time, care summary and accepted responsibility.
verification: Internal or external transfer is not completed merely by requesting it.

title: Discharge
requirement: MUST reconcile medications, final plan, summary, pending tests, review owner and patient instructions.
verification: A pending result survives discharge and reaches a responsible clinician.

title: Special dispositions
requirement: MUST handle leave, self-discharge/refusal, death and return according to approved local policy.
verification: Clinical event, bed release, billing and statutory documentation remain separate actions.

title: Programme episodes
requirement: MUST create scoped pregnancy, newborn, child and chronic-care episodes linked to the patient chart.
verification: An episode does not replace the longitudinal patient record.

title: Maternal context
requirement: MUST record relevant history, gestation/dating source, observations, assessments, plans and authorised referrals.
verification: Uncertain dating/history remains explicitly uncertain.

title: Labour and birth
requirement: MUST support local approved labour/birth documentation, team, procedures, outcomes and handover.
verification: Clinical decisions/thresholds come from a signed applicable protocol package.

title: Mother-infant linkage
requirement: MUST issue each infant an independent identity with relationship evidence and its own chart.
verification: Twins are distinct patients; access does not automatically follow a family label.

title: Postnatal follow-up
requirement: MUST assign maternal/newborn reviews, feeding/support observations and escalation under approved scope.
verification: Missed review creates an owned task, not just a notification.

title: Child growth and immunisation
requirement: MUST record measurements/units/age context, vaccine product/batch/administration and approved schedule version.
verification: No dose schedule or growth interpretation is fabricated from incomplete inputs.

title: Chronic continuity
requirement: MUST track patient-agreed goals, clinical measures, medicine reconciliation, reviews and self-reported observations.
verification: Patient-reported adherence is attributed and not presented as verified administration.

title: Sensitive access
requirement: MUST enforce age, representative, confidentiality and programme-specific access policies.
verification: Parent/caregiver authority is checked against applicable current rules.

title: Order authority
requirement: MUST record patient/encounter, requester, service, clinical context, priority and authorisation before release.
verification: An unsigned/unprivileged request cannot become an active order.

title: Specimen chain
requirement: MUST separate requested test, specimen collection, accession, receipt, rejection and analysis.
verification: Wrong/unlabelled specimens follow a documented rejection/recollection path.

title: Result structure
requirement: MUST preserve value or coded/text result, units, reference context, method, status, author and source.
verification: A numeric result without required unit/mapping enters review.

title: Verification
requirement: MUST distinguish preliminary, final, corrected, cancelled and entered-in-error results.
verification: A corrected report retains the earlier report and notifies affected reviewers.

title: Critical follow-up
requirement: MUST create an owned critical-result task under an approved laboratory/clinical policy and record acknowledgement.
verification: Message delivery is not clinician acknowledgement or patient contact.

title: Imaging
requirement: MUST link image study/accession, report and authorised image access; protect image metadata.
verification: A study URL cannot bypass patient/recipient authorisation.

title: External ingestion
requirement: MUST quarantine unmapped identities/codes and uncertain OCR until reviewed.
verification: A scanned external report is not presented as a verified structured fact.

title: Closure
requirement: MUST track review, clinical response and patient communication obligations.
verification: A final report cannot disappear from the review worklist after discharge.

title: Product identity
requirement: MUST store medication code/system/version, ingredient/product, form, strength and units as distinct concepts.
verification: Free-text display cannot silently substitute a different strength/product.

title: Prescribing
requirement: MUST require an authorised signed order with patient, indication/context, dose/unit, route, timing and duration/stop intent as applicable.
verification: No template or AI draft supplies an unreviewed treatment instruction.

title: Safety context
requirement: MUST surface allergy status, relevant current medicines and approved checking results with source freshness.
verification: Unknown allergies are not shown as no known allergies.

title: Dispensing
requirement: MUST record prescribed versus actually dispensed item, quantity, batch/expiry and permitted substitution approval.
verification: Stock issue does not falsely prove patient ingestion.

title: Administration
requirement: MUST link an actual administration/omission to the current order, patient, time, actor and reason.
verification: Retried requests cannot create a second dose record.

title: Reconciliation
requirement: MUST reconcile medicines at admission, transfer, review and discharge.
verification: Discontinued/changed orders remain historically visible and update future tasks.

title: Clinical stock
requirement: MUST maintain local lot movements, expiry/recall/quarantine, reservations and witnessed adjustments under policy.
verification: Duplicate sync cannot decrement stock twice.

title: Exceptions
requirement: MUST record hold, refusal, omission, shortage, adverse event and authorised emergency deviations without fabricating fulfilment.
verification: A shortage creates a responsible clinical/pharmacy action.

title: Clinical plan
requirement: MUST link procedure indication, patient, encounter, responsible team, site/context and approved privileges.
verification: A facility without the service capability cannot publish the procedure as available.

title: Consent and preparation
requirement: MUST record applicable consent/authority, pre-assessment, required investigations and readiness checks.
verification: A checklist does not substitute for the clinician assessment or valid authority.

title: Safety phases
requirement: MUST support team verification before anaesthesia/procedure, before incision/intervention and before leaving the room as applicable.
verification: Each required phase records actual participants, findings and exceptions.

title: Procedure record
requirement: MUST capture actual procedure, times, findings, specimens, implants/devices, complications and operator attestation.
verification: Planned procedure is not automatically recorded as performed.

title: Anaesthesia and recovery
requirement: MUST support the approved local anaesthesia record, monitoring, medicines and recovery handover.
verification: Required intra-procedure documentation remains locally usable offline.

title: Transfusion chain
requirement: MUST link clinical order, specimen/crossmatch evidence, identified component/unit, checks, issue, actual transfusion and reaction monitoring.
verification: AI cannot certify compatibility or substitute the blood-bank authorisation.

title: Traceability
requirement: MUST retain component/implant identifiers, stock/disposition and recall links.
verification: A recalled item can be traced to actual recipient records within authorised scope.

title: Handover
requirement: MUST transfer postoperative/procedure obligations, analgesia/order plans, pending specimens/results and complications to an accepted team.
verification: Recovery departure cannot orphan follow-up.

title: Price book
requirement: MUST version service, payer contract, currency, tax/discount applicability and effective dates.
verification: A charge uses the approved price applicable to its actual service event.

title: Charge evidence
requirement: MUST link charges to delivered/authorised billable service evidence and reversal reasons.
verification: Booking or failed consultation cannot automatically become earned service revenue.

title: Invoice and receipt
requirement: MUST separate invoice, payment intent, received cash/confirmed provider receipt, allocation and refund.
verification: A pending external payment is never labelled settled.

title: Ledger integrity
requirement: MUST use append-only balanced transaction groups, currency minor-unit amounts and immutable source keys.
verification: Duplicate callbacks or sync cannot duplicate financial effects.

title: Payer split
requirement: MUST support patient, sponsor and institutional responsibility with prior authorisation/claim state where applicable.
verification: Benefit exhaustion cannot silently charge an unconsenting patient.

title: Claims lifecycle
requirement: MUST preserve submitted version, acknowledgement, rejection, adjudication, remittance and appeals.
verification: Claim submission does not imply payer approval or payment.

title: Controls
requirement: MUST require reasoned independent approval for refunds, write-offs and sensitive adjustments.
verification: Maker cannot approve their own transaction outside an adopted exception.

title: Optional accounting
requirement: MUST export/reconcile journals to optional general ledger without making it a care prerequisite.
verification: Accounting outage queues postings while clinical and care billing work continues.

title: Progressive account
requirement: MUST support verified personal access and optional dependant/caregiver relationships without long mandatory onboarding.
verification: User can seek help before completing unrelated profile sections.

title: Today dashboard
requirement: MUST prioritise next care action, active episode, due plan/medicine/review and family subject.
verification: An empty account receives useful start actions rather than demo records.

title: Conversation
requirement: MUST identify assistant versus human, preserve source context and offer direct actions.
verification: The patient can open their care plan without navigating a chat transcript.

title: History and progress
requirement: MUST show patient-readable timeline, plans, medications, appointments, results and progress with provenance.
verification: Unreviewed results and uncertain self-reports are not presented as clinical conclusions.

title: Family isolation
requirement: MUST isolate every subject chart, conversation, draft, reminder and sharing grant.
verification: Switching a child profile cannot expose an adult relative record.

title: Reminders and routines
requirement: MUST provide controllable neutral notifications and self-reports without changing prescribed instructions.
verification: Reminder completion is not recorded as verified clinical adherence.

title: Attentive handoff
requirement: MUST show request status, responsible team, next step and truthful expected update.
verification: Delayed clinical acknowledgement creates an owned service exception.

title: Accessible support
requirement: MUST support keyboard/screen reader, low-bandwidth text, manual location and clear emergency access.
verification: No compulsory video/voice or inaccessible map blocks help.

title: Prioritised worklist
requirement: MUST show assigned/unclaimed work, urgency source, due obligations, service context and workload.
verification: A clinician can identify the next accountable task without scanning unrelated dashboards.

title: Claim and coverage
requirement: MUST enforce one current claim owner and valid privileges/capacity for the service.
verification: Concurrent claims do not create two independent treating owners.

title: Source summary
requirement: MUST prepare an editable summary with provenance, negation, contradictions and pending results.
verification: AI cannot invent an examination or hide an important conflicting fact.

title: Drafting and signing
requirement: MUST support structured notes, drafts, references and intentional authenticated signing.
verification: Accepting a draft is distinct from signing and releasing an order.

title: Result and follow-up
requirement: MUST organise due results, plans, recalls and patient communication with accepted handover.
verification: A finished appointment does not close an unresolved result.

title: Scheduling and workload
requirement: MUST show actual commitments, leave/coverage and limits; optional HR is not required.
verification: Time includes preparation, documentation and follow-up, not only call duration.

title: References
requirement: MUST retrieve current approved references with source/version and applicability.
verification: Unsupported/expired references are visibly restricted.

title: Override and learning
requirement: MUST allow authorised clinical override with reason and reviewable audit; no silent model training.
verification: Override informs evaluation without automatically changing policy.

title: Independent modules
requirement: MUST independently enable accounting, procurement, HR and payroll by contracted facility/organisation.
verification: Disabling ERP leaves core clinical and care-finance functions usable.

title: Accounting
requirement: MUST support chart of accounts, journals, AP/AR, cash/bank reconciliation, budgets, periods and controlled close.
verification: Every posting group balances per currency and retains source linkage.

title: Clinical posting interface
requirement: MUST consume care-finance journals idempotently with acknowledgement and difference reports.
verification: Accounting failure cannot block care billing or duplicate revenue.

title: Procurement
requirement: MUST support requisition, approvals, supplier/quotation, purchase order, receiving and invoice matching.
verification: Procurement receipt creates an authorised stock movement rather than rewriting clinical dispensing history.

title: HR
requirement: MUST support employment records, contracts, assignments, leave and attendance under scoped access.
verification: An HR job title alone cannot grant clinical privileges.

title: Payroll
requirement: MUST version country/employer pay rules, approved inputs, calculation, review, payment file and posting.
verification: No invented universal tax/pension deductions are activated.

title: Segregation
requirement: MUST separate supplier/employee maintenance, approval, payment and review with reasoned exceptions.
verification: A user cannot silently create and pay a beneficiary under incompatible duties.

title: Privacy and integration
requirement: MUST keep salary/employment information separate from patient charts and executive health aggregates.
verification: An exported clinical report contains no payroll details.
